methods.label: Count complete daily allotments
methods.explanation:
Combine the morning and evening meals to find how much food a complete day requires:
\[
\frac13+\frac14=\frac7{12}\text{ can}.
\]
The number of daily allotments contained in \(6\) cans is
\[
6\div\frac7{12}=\frac{72}{7}=10+\frac27.
\]
Thus the food lasts through \(10\) complete days. To determine when it runs out on the next day, find the amount remaining:
\[
6-10\cdot\frac7{12}=\frac16\text{ can}.
\]
This is less than the usual morning meal of \(\frac13\) can, so the cat finishes the food from the box on the eleventh morning.

Counting the starting Monday as day \(1\), the following Monday is day \(8\). Days \(9\), \(10\), and \(11\) are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. The answer is Thursday, choice C.
